LESSON: MAKING TECHNIQUES

Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: PICTURE
Topic 1.5: MAKING TECHNIQUES

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about MAKING TECHNIQUES. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why do we paint?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify painting materials • Organize learner to paint 3. What can we paint
2. use finger technique for using finger technique. painting • Learners to appreciate own

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify painting materials • Organize learner to paint 3. What can we paint
   In simple words: practise until you can identify painting materials • Organize learner to paint 3. What can we paint. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. use finger technique for using finger technique. painting • Learners to appreciate own
   In simple words: practise until you can use finger technique for using finger technique. painting • Learners to appreciate own. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about MAKING TECHNIQUES using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about MAKING TECHNIQUES in the examples.
2. Explain MAKING TECHNIQUES to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand MAKING TECHNIQUES.
4. Show that you can: identify painting materials • Organize learner to paint 3. What can we paint

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about MAKING TECHNIQUES using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is MAKING TECHNIQUES important for a PP2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Guide Learners to identify 1. Why do we paint? MAKING 4 lessons the learner should be able to; painting materials 2. What do we use to paint? a) identify painting materials
2. Organize learner to paint 3. What can we paint b) paint freely on paper for freely in pairs/groups familiarization of materials
3. Paint objects c) use finger technique for using finger technique. painting
4. Appreciate own d) paint freely for enjoyment and others paintings e) appreciate own and others
5. Be guided painted work to take photos of their paintings . Core-Competence

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do we paint?
2. What do we use to paint?

SECTION: REMEMBER

2. use finger technique for using finger technique. painting • Learners to appreciate own
